# /specialists-team — Specialists (unaffiliated)

> Backed up 2026-11-10. Call the whole team with `/specialists-team`; it goes to the lead.

## Purpose

Stand-alone specialist bots that are not part of a named fleet.

## Routing

Call directly. Blue-Ocean-Inventor finds ideas; RightsScout covers IP research; MechSensorForge covers sensors/hardware/codecs; atomic-illuminator covers forensic visual text recovery.

## Members

| Call name | Bot | Role |
|---|---|---|
| [`/bot-blue-ocean-inventor`](../../bots/bot-blue-ocean-inventor/README.md) | Blue-Ocean-Inventor | Finds and honestly judges low-competition ideas and inventions |
| [`/bot-rightsscout`](../../bots/bot-rightsscout/README.md) | RightsScout · Copyright & Patents | IP research assistant (copyright, patents, trademarks) |
| [`/bot-mechsensorforge`](../../bots/bot-mechsensorforge/README.md) | MechSensorForge | Mechatronics / AFM / LiDAR / SAR / pixel-games specialist |
| [`/bot-atomic-illuminator`](../../bots/bot-atomic-illuminator/README.md) | atomic-illuminator | Forensic visual text recovery / epigraphy agent |

## Rules

All members follow [BOT-COMMON-RULES.md](../../BOT-COMMON-RULES.md) plus each bot's own rules in its README.

## How to re-create the team

1. Re-create each member from its README ("How to re-create"), lead first.
2. Tell every member who the lead is and where to report.
3. Point Audrey's requests for this team at `/bot-proofy`.
